decisions.geometry: Reverted: no Receipt CPU/readiness gain; 83.3ms rendering peak remained.
decisions.fade: Reverted: CPU down 7-13%, but initial readiness unchanged and repeated Receipt trace reached 99.947ms.
decisions.retained: Fixture first-callback and list-readiness timing; per-hitch CPU-window attribution; audit results. Production client code unchanged.

metricNotes: CPU milliseconds are app-process CPU time across threads, not utilization.
firstCallbackLatencyMs includes the wait from phase start until the first CADisplayLink callback executes.
maxCallbackGapMs omits work before the first callback; retain both metrics.
listReadyMs checks populated visible cells in the hierarchy, not completed rendering.
RSS values are checkpoints, not peak/long-session memory.
Trace CPU samples and raw fixture process CPU are different measurements.
Hitch and inclusive stack intervals overlap; do not sum into wall-time percentages.
Baseline trace 1 uses the preceding fixture without firstCallbackLatencyMs/listReadyMs.
Geometry changes only Receipts; its other tabs are controls.
All recorded thermal states were nominal.

aligned.note: Hitches are assigned by interval start. Rendering contexts and inclusive CPU stacks can overlap; do not add their durations or counts into wall-time percentages. Push intervals end at field readiness, not animation completion. Launch/seed work outside the signposts is excluded.
